name: ts-business-app-starter
description: A production-ready business application starter built with NestJS, Fastify, Drizzle and React.

scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/api-client build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @ts-business-app-starter/server --filter @ts-business-app-starter/admin --filter @ts-business-app-starter/web dev
scripts.dev:server: corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/server dev
scripts.dev:admin: corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/api-client build && corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/admin dev
scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/api-client build && corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/web dev
scripts.check: corepack pnpm check:starter-version && corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
scripts.db:generate: corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/server db:generate
scripts.db:bootstrap: corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/server db:bootstrap
scripts.db:studio: corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @ts-business-app-starter/server db:studio
